title: CODE-ONLY-ORDER: give decision decision-2026-11-15-drain-all-1-complete-all-work- a code consumer
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** ledger row has no code consumer
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/decision-ledger.json::decision-2026-11-15-drain-all-1-complete-all-work-drain-all-issues-merge-all-prs ; its probe names an existing code or data file that enforces the decision, and the id leaves doctrine/standing-order-baseline.json
**Status:** open

Turn the decision into a check, policy value or loop, repoint the probe, then run `python3 -m foundation standingorder --baseline`.
